verdict.rationale: Jira documents a broad REST API, published as a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec with 433 paths, and community users confirm they query data and create issues through it. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that every UI capability is reachable through the API, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of UI/API parity, coverage evidence for admin and configuration actions (workflows, boards, views), and independent verification that no UI-only gaps exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Atlassian publishes the Jira Cloud platform REST API as a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 document
the ability to execute useful queries via REST on the data stored in there
